BL-678 — Batch-mode claims write no progress sidecar — a healthy in-flight parcel is indistinguishable from a lost one, and the coordinator nearly re-forwarded a duplicate
Approval context: Split out of BL-648's source at spec time (its 2026-07-25 16:28-16:50 sibling incident): a cleaner BATCH claim wrote no claim-progress record, so the coordinator, chasing an apparently-stalled parcel, nearly forwarded a duplicate at 16:47 — stopped only by a human. BL-648 fixes the dead-owner half …
